gameDescriptionHtml:
High-Speed Aerial Racing: Soar through the alien skies at incredible speeds, weaving through energy rings suspended in the atmosphere. Master the art of precision flying as you navigate hairpin turns, tight corridors, and gravity-defying drops.

Time Trial Challenge: Race against the world in over 20 heart-pounding time trial circuits. Every millisecond counts and only the most skilled pilots will conquer the leaderboard. Can you set the ultimate record and become the undisputed champion?

Boost Through Ring Mastery: Collect speed-boosting rings strategically scattered throughout each circuit. Skilfully catching them not only adds to your speed but also avoids overheating of your flying unit.

Changing weather conditions: Adapt your flying skills to the changing weather system and the diverse lighting conditions.

Alien World Exploration: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning alien planet and its otherworldly landscapes, vibrant atmospheres, and mysterious landmarks, Fly at your own leisure, free from the clock pressure.

Unlockables: Complete races/achievements to unlock more circuits and skin colours to fly with. Discover the planet’s “secrets” to unlock the ultimate flying machine…

Reward system based on performance (1/2/3 stars)

Achievements: Over 60 Steam achievements
